name: Objects, work not started
query:
SELECT 
    ps.name AS "Project ID:Link/Project Setup:150",
    ps.project_name AS "Project Name:Data:200",
    ps.task AS "Task:Data:150",
    ps.team_name AS "Work Team:Link/Work Team:150",
    ps.team_leader AS "Team Leader:Link/User:150",
    ps.status AS "Status:Data:100",
    ps.expected_end_date AS "End Date:Date:120"
FROM 
    `tabProject Setup` ps
WHERE 
    ps.status = 'Open'
    AND ps.name NOT IN (
        SELECT pa.project__client
        FROM `tabProject Attendance` pa
        WHERE pa.docstatus = 1
    )
ORDER BY ps.modified DESC;
